scope: Six existing ASL words; no new supported vocabulary
training: Original training references plus new clips; unsupported DRINK, WATER, BOOK training negatives
validation: Original and additional validation recordings; candidate tuning only on validation
freshTest: Six additional recordings per word and per unsupported sign from source test split, excluding every original selected member. Test payloads downloaded and evaluated only after candidate selection is frozen.
separation: Enforce source participant IDs disjoint across train/validation/test and unique video hashes. New test recordings, but test signer population has been used in previous regression evaluations; not a fresh-population benchmark.
candidates: Expanded DTW reference model with validation rejection thresholds
Compact temporal convolution network on hand shape, trajectories, and upper-body-relative location
nuisanceNegatives: Synthetic still hands, camera drift, no hands and landmark jitter, separately reported. These do not substitute for physical webcam recordings of ordinary hand movements.
selection: Minimize validation 4*wrong + missed + 4*unsupported false accepts. Freeze candidate configuration before fresh test.
promotion: Correct count must exceed deployed baseline on identical fresh test; wrong count and unsupported false accepts must not exceed baseline. Automatic-boundary and real-time browser latency checks must pass. Physical-webcam ordinary-motion validation remains required for a claim of general live-camera improvement.
liveSite: Keep existing model until all applicable gates pass. Do not tune on fresh test outcomes.
bodyFeatures: Center-frame upper-body reference held fixed over the 30 hand-motion samples; temporal network resamples to 32 frames.
browserBudget: Classifier p95 <=150ms in 20 post-warmup Chromium runs on this host; extraction excluded and separately assessed by real-time virtual-camera replay. This is not a phone or physical-webcam performance guarantee.
